verdict.rationale: Khoj's setup docs have provider API keys (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY) supplied as server environment variables, so model credentials are separated from chat. Nothing else in the pack addresses credential handling. missing for 10: a documented secrets store, redaction of secrets in chat history or logs, guidance against pasting credentials into chat, credential handling for integrations such as GitHub, Notion and code execution, and independent corroboration.
